sources.section_title: Verbs conjugated with avoir or être
sources.source_text: Six verbs among those conjugated with être in the passé composé (sortir, rentrer, monter, descendre, passer, retourner) are conjugated with avoir and follow the avoir agreement when a direct object follows the verb. In these cases, the meaning of the verb has changed.

grammar_rules.rule_name: Verbs with avoir or être (six verbs)
grammar_rules.summary: Sortir, rentrer, monter, descendre, passer, retourner can use avoir when transitive, with meaning change.
grammar_rules.explanation: When followed by a direct object, these verbs use avoir and the meaning changes (often 'to take/bring up/down/out/in, to spend, to turn over').
grammar_rules.formation: avoir + past participle when direct object present
usage: to express taking/bringing something, spending time, turning over
exceptions: Only these six verbs switch to avoir; other être verbs do not
The switch occurs only when a direct object follows the verb
With avoir, the past participle agrees with a preceding direct object
agreement_rules: follow avoir agreement: past participle agrees with preceding direct object
grammar_rules.word_order: direct object after the verb → avoir + past participle; no direct object → être + past participle
grammar_rules.affirmative_form: Ils ont monté les malles au grenier.
transformations: Ils ont monté les malles au grenier.
Elle a sorti la voiture du garage.
J'ai passé trois semaines à Tokyo.
avoir + participe passé when a direct object follows
common_traps: Meaning difference between être and avoir versions

sources.section_title: Introduction to the passé composé
sources.source_text: The passé composé is one of the tenses colloquially used in French to talk about past events. It is built of two parts: the auxiliary or helping verb, avoir or être, + a past participle.

sources.section_title: The passé composé with être
sources.source_text: Some verbs use être instead of avoir in the passé composé. It is very important to memorize the (finite) list of verbs conjugated with être.
